title: Development of methodologies for virus detection in soybean and wheat seeds
author: Botelho, Martins, et al.

steps.title: Prepare seed samples for extraction
steps.instruction: Generate infected seed material, harvest seeds, store them, and ready healthy seed controls for RNA extraction.

substeps.instruction: Mechanically inoculate soybean plants with SMV isolate 165.09 (GenBank KC331990) and wheat cv. Guabiju with WSMV isolate 915 (GenBank KC152463.1).
Grow inoculated plants in a greenhouse until seeds mature, then harvest the seeds.
Store all harvested seeds at 4 °C until the maceration step begins.
Collect additional seeds from healthy plants: soybean (multiple accessions), wheat cv. BRS Guabiju and BRS Guamirim, triticale cv. BRS Saturno and BRS Ulisses, and maize hybrid HS201.
Incubate wheat and triticale seeds with water (no volume specified) to soften the tissues before maceration.

steps.title: Extract RNA using CTAB buffer
steps.instruction: Lyse frozen seed material with pre‑heated CTAB extraction buffer and purify the aqueous phase through sequential organic extractions.

substeps.instruction: In a fume hood, add 5 mL of pre‑heated (65 °C) total RNA extraction buffer (2 % w/v CTAB, 2 % w/v PVP‑40, 100 mM Tris‑HCl pH 8.0, 25 mM EDTA, 2 M NaCl, 0.1 % spermidine, 2 % β‑mercaptoethanol) to the frozen seed samples.
Incubate the mixture in a 65 °C water bath for 30 min, vortexing every 5 min.
Add an equal volume of Chloroform:Isoamyl alcohol (24:1) to each tube, vortex for 30 s, then centrifuge at 10 000 × g for 20 min at 4 °C.
Transfer 1 mL of the aqueous supernatant (above the white phase) to a 2.0 mL RNase‑free microcentrifuge tube and add an equal volume of Chloroform:Isoamyl alcohol.
Vortex briefly and centrifuge at 10 000 × g for 10 min at 4 °C.
Transfer the resulting supernatant (1.0 mL) to a RNase‑free 1.5 mL microcentrifuge tube, taking care not to disturb the interphase.
Add 0.5 mL of 96–100 % ethanol to the supernatant and mix.

steps.title: Purify RNA with RNeasy columns
steps.instruction: Bind the ethanol‑mixed RNA to silica columns, wash, and elute high‑quality RNA for downstream analysis.

substeps.instruction: Immediately load the supernatant‑ethanol mixture onto Qiagen RNeasy RNA binding columns (0.75 mL capacity per column), skipping any filtration step.
Spin the columns at 10 000 × g for 30 s at room temperature.
If the sample volume exceeds the column capacity, load the remaining mixture onto the same column until the entire sample has been processed.
Proceed with the standard RNeasy kit washing and desalting steps as described in the manufacturer’s protocol.
Elute the purified RNA with 50 µL of RNase‑free water.
Store the eluted RNA at –80 °C until further use.
